title: PURSUE file: law enforcement officers report orbs and an orb mothership at a security site
place_text: National security site in the western US

tellings.quote: there's this one report that came out about these law enforcement agents that are at a national security site somewhere uh in the west and they have all these interactions with orbs and one's even a mother ship of orbs that launches other orbs from it.

plain: Law enforcement officers guarding a national security site somewhere in the western US had run-in after run-in with glowing balls of light, or orbs, and one of them was a "mother ship of orbs" that launched other orbs from it. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet describes this report to Michels. He says it is one of a batch of released reports he calls the PURSUE files, and he gives no date and no exact site. If it is true, something unknown is moving freely over one of the country's guarded sites.
